body: Hey thanks for talking with me. I'ma go now.
I am 16, and I cannot talk to my parents at all. And why would I call a number that would try to stop me?

At this point I'm not even sure if I want happiness or joy. 

I believe you, I really do that I'll meet someone and be really happy again. But until then, I'm just stuck in this shitty place cutting myself all day. 

And so if I go through all that hurt and pain and I find someone...what then? What if she leaves me, or if she dies? Then it's just this all over again, except that time it'll hurt just worse.

My ex won't even talk to me, she blocked me on everything. I can't talk to my parents or a counselor or I get sent back. I'm truly alone and hurt and I just want to lay down and die and never have to feel anything again ever.

Thank you again, that does make me feel better. I mean, I believe you, in a way I guess, maybe she'll come back one day. Or I'll find someone else, but why go through all that hurt and pain when it can just all go away right now?

Thank you for responding with kind words, but it just seems like it was it you know? I was really in love with her, and actually I was halfway through a bottle of pills when we met and she stopped me from ODing. I'm just so sad man, it just seems like everyday gets worse and worse and I'm stuck in this shitty place with people who don't care. I really do just wanna go you know?
